function.arguments:
{"script":"cd temp_check
tr -d '\n\r' < original_var.txt | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' > normalized_var.txt
# Step 3
grep -P "(^\s|\s$)" normalized_var.txt > whitespace_log.txt || touch whitespace_log.txt
# Step 4
VAL=$(cat normalized_var.txt)
printf "%f" "$VAL" > canonical_numeric.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "$VAL" > canonical_numeric.txt
if [ "$(cat normalized_var.txt)" = "$(cat canonical_numeric.txt)" ]; then echo "no change" > coercion_log.txt; else echo "changed" > coercion_log.txt; fi
# Step 5
if grep -qP "^[-+]?\d+$" canonical_numeric.txt; then echo "true" > digit_check.txt; else echo "false" > digit_check.txt; fi
# Step 6
if grep -qP "[\.eE]" canonical_numeric.txt; then echo "contains fraction or exponent" > fraction_exponent_check.txt; else echo "no fraction or exponent" > fraction_exponent_check.txt; fi
# Step 7
echo "Digit check: $(cat digit_check.txt)" > integer_candidate_status.txt
echo "Fraction check: $(cat fraction_exponent_check.txt)" >> integer_candidate_status.txt
# Step 8
echo "all preparatory checks are complete and that the system is ready to perform the final determination and output" > ready_for_final.txt
"}
